run(parents): restores a node with TransformNode.__new__ and __setstate__, as pickle does, from a state whose _parents holds the given objects (None for a parent that no longer exists), and returns the object each rebuilt reference leads to.
pinned_behavior: typical: each parent is kept, in order, and its reference leads to the same object.
edge: parents given as None are dropped; an empty state.
invalid: a parent that cannot be referenced weakly (an int) raises TypeError.
not_pinned_on_purpose: What happens when a parent object dies after the restore: the callback is bound to the pop of the dictionary that was in the state (self._parents before the assignment), not to the new one, and that old dictionary keeps the parents alive through the bound method. That depends on reference counting and on the lifetime of objects outside the unit, not on a returned value.
